changeSet.author: nexus-4lnn1.1.2
changeSet.comment: Creates nexus.canary_query_ring (RDR-230: the recall canary's persisted query ring, one row per distinct query vector per collection) with exactly-one-embedding and digest-length CHECKs, a primary key on (tenant_id, collection, vector_digest), an ON DELETE CASCADE foreign key to catalog_collections (tenant_id, name, embedding_model), and tenant RLS (ENABLE + FORCE + tenant_isolation). A new table, so no data mutation of existing rows.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE nexus.canary_query_ring ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL, embedding_model TEXT NOT NULL, embedding_384 nexus.vector(384), embedding_768 nexus.vector(768), embedding_1024 nexus.vector(1024), vector_digest BYTEA NOT NULL, added_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT canary_query_ring_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, collection, vector_digest), CONSTRAINT canary_query_ring_exactly_one_embedding CHECK (num_nonnulls(embedding_384, embedding_768, embedding_1024) = 1), CONSTRAINT canary_query_ring_digest_len CHECK (octet_length(vector_digest) = 32), CONSTRAINT canary_query_ring_collection_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, collection, embedding_model) REFERENCES nexus.catalog_collections (tenant_id, name, embedding_model) ON DELETE CASCADE );
ALTER TABLE nexus.canary_query_ring ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE nexus.canary_query_ring FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON nexus.canary_query_ring USING (tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true)) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true));

rollback.sql: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON nexus.canary_query_ring; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.canary_query_ring;

changeSet.author: nexus-4lnn1.1.2
changeSet.comment: nexus.canary_query_ring_upsert(tenant, collections, models, vectors, digests) RETURNS integer (RDR-230): upserts each entry of a batch into its collection's ring (insert, or refresh added_at when the digest is already there), skipping an entry whose collection is gone (foreign-key failure per entry, S6) or whose vector has an unsupported dimension, then trims every ring it wrote to the 32 newest rows younger than 30 days. SECURITY INVOKER with a pinned search_path, so RLS applies. One new function and its GRANT EXECUTE; no data effect: a function definition only.

rollback.sql: REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION nexus.canary_query_ring_upsert(text, text[], text[], text[], bytea[]) FROM nexus_svc; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.canary_query_ring_upsert(text, text[], text[], text[], bytea[]);
